title: Left-neighbour source for a work cell
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T,t,r,j$ be natural numbers, with $\tau$ a work-track index. The source is bit $j$ of the block for the cell at time $t$, track $\tau$, and coordinate $r-1$, if $r\ne0$; otherwise it is the constant false bit.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean tape alphabet
caveat: The payload does not define the cell-to-instruction indexing function.
